entry.title: Super Crazy Rhythm Castle v0.29.0r2
entry.content:
# v0.29.1 — Player movement repair
**October 12, 2026. Client 0.76.1 / APWorld 0.29.0 (unchanged).**
## Fixed
- Fixed the captured player-movement stalls where animation stayed smooth but movement repeatedly slowed or stopped, including after songs and area transitions. Very short input-movement updates now accumulate their elapsed time before being applied, avoiding the observed acceleration resets. - Kept native rendering and frame-rate preferences; this repair does not force fullscreen or a 50 FPS cap.
## Diagnostics and documentation
- Expanded opt-in F8 movement captures with bounded player-update timing records, movement speed values and repair counters. Detailed recording is active only during a capture. - Reorganized the README and current documentation, removed contradictory setup/version guidance, and archived superseded plans and test checkpoints with an index. - Updated the current issue list and recorded the newly completed gameplay acceptance tests.
## Updating
Close the game and replace the client files with **RhythmCastleAP-v0.76.1.zip**, retaining the included licenses. Keep your configuration, current seed and associated save. The APWorld remains **0.29.0**; its logic, IDs, options, item placements, bundle mappings and Star gates are unchanged. An APWorld download is included for convenience, not as a required upgrade from 0.29.0.
## Validation
The movement implementation was accepted in gameplay before its version-only release bump: initial movement, after a Music Lab song, room changes, restart, Hypno Pan NPC movement, stopping, reversing, gentle analogue input, solid-wall collision and pause/resume. Diagnostic samples confirmed the repair active.
Automated coverage includes player timing boundaries, one normal and three faulty recorded timing streams, the timing recorder, movement capture, Montage timing, notification bursts and cassette bundles. All 44 client regression projects passed for publication. The Release build, repository validator, 10 packaging tests and final archive checks passed. NuGet vulnerability metadata could not be fetched; this is not a completed dependency-security audit. Managed tests do not prove every native configuration.
Additional tests confirmed Star-blocked entrance retry without area reload; immediate item receipt/deposit and persistence; original Plant Pipes/Hip Glasses pickups; Meoo/Plunger/Star Eater checks; Superstar insertion and medal preview; and Quicksand/Bloody Tears chests without duplicate vanilla rewards. These validate existing behavior rather than introduce new features in this patch.
## Known limits
Intermittent note-affecting performance stalls remain under investigation; the movement repair is not a claim that all frame hitches are fixed. Extended-session and multiplayer movement coverage remains incomplete. Triple cassette bundles and large notification batches have automated coverage but less native acceptance than the tested paths. Native route/modeling uncertainties remain listed in [known issues](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.1/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).
See the [AI disclosure](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.1/docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md) and [testing record](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.1/docs/TESTING.md).

entry.title: Death's Door v0.4.1
entry.content:
It is here! After a hiatus, there is now a new version of the Death's Door Archipelago Randomizer and APWorld!
**We're still in beta** Since this is built upon a very stable v0.3.0, there is no concern for crashes or major game breaking bugs, but we'll leave it here for a bit to see if anything does come up.
## To Use **- Randomizer Mod:** Download the attached `plugins.zip` and extract it to `<DDInstallPath>\BepInEx\plugins`. This zip contains the latest versions of all required and recommended mods. **- APWorld:** Download the attached APWorld and drag it into your Archipelago cutom_worlds folder, or simply double click to install it. Make sure to restart your Archipelago launcher after installing.
## New Location Features **- Soul Vault Randomizer:** You can now make the stat upgrades in the Soul Vault into locations that send items intot he multiworld when bought. You can also receive the stat upgrades as progressive items. There are options for placing extra stat boosts in the multiworld. You red it right, our lil crow can now be ultrabuffed! **- Soul vault price modifiers:** **Vanilla** (same as always), **Shuffled** (Same prices, just shuffled between all the upgrades). **Random** (Progressive price increase remains, but all prices will be between a range set in your YAML) **- Seed planting as locations:** Every (X) seeds you plant can now send a check. You can set the amount of seed checks and how many seeds planted sends a check in your YAML up to a maximum of 50.
## New Logic Features **- Plant Pot Tracker:** The Universal Tracker map now shows plant pots in and out of logic. A plant pot will be marked as checked when a seed is planted. No more getting lost/wondering which pots you've already planted! **- Coloured Key Gate Tracker Logic:** When unlocking a gate that requires a coloured key, the Universal Tracker map changes any locations locked behind it as in logic. Before this update, it would only mark locations in logic when you received all keys of the required colour.
## Bug Fixes/Adjustments - Fixed logic for Camp of Crows and Castle Lockstone Doors - Fixed minor filler issues for more reliable seed generation
## Notes If you have an idea and have the ability to contribute, see the contributing section of the README for details!

entry.title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror v0.4.1
entry.content:
## v0.4.1
### New Features - Choose Shadow, Ivory, Citrus, White or Lavender from Kirby Squeak Squad as your starting Kirby color (Issue #599). They're also included in the random color pool.
### Improvements - Configure one-hit starts through Minimum Health and Maximum Health. The redundant One-Hit Mode selector is removed from templates; older YAML presets still convert automatically (Issue #955). - Reopening a game remembers items confirmed by the updated client, so food, lives, batteries, invincibility and traps are not applied again and old receive messages stay quiet. Permanent items can still be restored when loading an older save. If an interruption leaves an item's delivery uncertain, the client asks you to resolve it instead of guessing (Issue #952, PR #954).
### Known Limitations - Progression: The entire game is still only two spheres. This means you can complete almost the entirety of Kirby and the Amazing Mirror without ever having to receive an item, except open the Dimension Mirror. In other words, you can do everything in the game except defeat Dark Mind without ever receiving an item from another player. This is a consequence of the original game design. We have plans to gate your progression in other ways, but they all require coding/hacking in intentional blockers. - Localization: Only the North American ROM is supported. All AP notifications are in English. - Native sprites and animations: Chests still show their original item sprite and collection animation. Statues still show their original ability. - mGBA: notifications appear as plain text in the **Archipelago Connector** scripting panel, which must be visible. They do not appear over the game image.
### Bug Fixes - Keep Kirby and the phone, life icon and health display colors together, including Pink. Random-per-room takes priority over a saved owned-paint choice, then the AP static color, then default Pink; treasure-room choices now survive native save/load (Issue #918). - Restore acknowledged lever pulls after resets and reconnects, including already-loaded levers, without granting their separate wall items (Issue #949). Regenerate the ROM patch for immediate visual recovery. - Pause new item deliveries during the update that applies an incoming DeathLink, including links received while checking locations. Items already being delivered can still finish, and new deliveries resume after Kirby respawns (Issue #944).
### Internal Changes - List ability items, including guaranteed starting abilities, in `items.json` for tracker support (Issues #957, #961). - Updated to AP 0.6.8 (Issue #933)
### Additional fixes included from main
- Restore packaged region discovery on Python 3.11 by using a package resource anchor. - Fix room-sanity generation by making each physical room check reachable from its valid compartment and restoring the missing Moonlight 2-05 lower descent (Issues #945, #969). - Random-per-room colors now update Kirby and the HUD when native palette transformations remain enabled during gameplay (Issue #966). Regenerate the ROM patch. - Allow the six guaranteed starting ability receipts and notices during the tutorial. Other items stay deferred, and Sword still requires its ability item (Issue #967).

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.2.4
entry.content:
CTR Archipelago 0.2.4 is out. Here's the short version. [Full release notes are on AP-Pie](https://ap-pie.com/ctr/releases/0-2-4).
[Setup guide (ap-pie.com)](https://ap-pie.com/guides/ctr) · [SETUP.md](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/main/SETUP.md) · [SETUP.md as shipped](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/v0.2.4/SETUP.md)
## What's new since 0.2.3
- **Generation:** big rooms generate much faster. - **Fewer refused YAMLs:** about 4 in 10 random YAMLs got refused in our tests, down from almost 8 in 10. Every YAML that worked on 0.2.3 still works. - **Race-loss DeathLink:** only sends when you haven't won that race yet and it's in logic for you. Rooms from before 0.2.4 keep the old rule. - **Trial pads:** the Slide Coliseum and Turbo Track pads no longer trap you in the warp after a Collect. - **Bosses:** only bosses you beat yourself count, so a Collect can't finish a Bosses goal or softlock any_percent ([#458](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/458)). - **Itemsanity:** finished pads stay open if you have a weapon with an open check ([#452](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/452)). - **Slide Coliseum:** if a seed has fewer than 10 Sapphire Relics, the pad opens at the number it has. - **Extracted assets:** no more BIN prompt on every launch ([#444](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/444)). - **Demo Camera trap:** L2 no longer breaks it ([#454](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/454)).
## Downloads
On Windows, grab `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.4-windows-x86.zip`. On Linux or Steam Deck, grab `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.4-linux-x86.tar.gz` (glibc 2.36 or newer). Both include the client and the matching `ctr.apworld`. You can keep playing a 0.2.3 room on the 0.2.4 client. For new seeds, use the 0.2.4 client and APWorld together. Hosting needs Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer, and 0.6.8 works too.
The separate `ctr.apworld` and `Crash.Team.Racing.yaml` are for hosts. Use the `.sha256` files to check your downloads. `manifest.json` and `manifest.json.minisig` are the signed manifest; the full notes explain how to check it. The `.debug` files help with crash reports. You don't need them to play. You need your own NTSC-U disc, no game data is included. The client isn't code-signed.
Known issues: a full-accessibility CTR slot next to a minimal-accessibility slot can fail to generate on some seeds (just generate again). entry.title: Wedding Witch v0.1.0r2
entry.content:
## Changes since 0.1.0
- Achievements pay out their Love Coins again: each room now keeps its own achievement progress instead of sharing your normal save's. - The main menu's **Shop** button can be reached with the arrow keys and gamepad.
The apworld and YAML are unchanged from 0.1.0, so existing seeds keep working.
Archipelago randomizer for **Wedding Witch**. The witch's upgrade shop stops selling upgrades — all 73 levels become Archipelago items — and its shelves are restocked with checks instead, which is what Love Coins buy now.
A default seed is 82 checks: the three potions offered after every stage, the boss beaten in each of the six witch forms on Nightmare (once in any form on the lower difficulties), and 20 shop shelves.
## What's in this release
| File | Where it goes | |---|---| | `WeddingWitchArchipelago-0.1.1.zip` | unzips into the game folder | | `wedding_witch.apworld` | your Archipelago install's `custom_worlds/` | | `WeddingWitch.yaml` | your Archipelago install's `Players/`, after editing |
## 1. Install BepInEx
Wedding Witch is a Unity **Mono** build, so it needs the Mono flavour of BepInEx 6 from the [bleeding-edge builds page](https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be). The IL2CPP builds will not load. Take the newest one for your platform:
- **Windows** — `BepInEx-Unity.Mono-win-x64-6.0.0-be.*.zip` - **Linux** — `BepInEx-Unity.Mono-linux-x64-6.0.0-be.*.zip`
Unzip it into the game folder — the one holding `Wedding Witch.exe` on Windows or `Wedding Witch.x86_64` on Linux. Steam's *Manage → Browse local files* will take you there.
Then launch the game once and quit. That first run creates `BepInEx/plugins`, and it will not create it until the game has actually started.
**Linux only**, two extra steps:
```sh chmod +x run_bepinex.sh ```
and set the game's Steam launch options to:
``` ./run_bepinex.sh %command% ```
Without the launch options BepInEx is never loaded and the game simply runs unmodded. Windows needs neither — its BepInEx hooks the executable directly.
## 2. Install the mod
Unzip `WeddingWitchArchipelago-0.1.1.zip` into the same game folder. It carries its own `BepInEx/plugins/...` path, so you should end up with:
``` Wedding Witch/BepInEx/plugins/WeddingWitchArchipelago/WeddingWitchArchipelago.dll ```
## 3. Install the apworld
Drop `wedding_witch.apworld` into `custom_worlds/` in your Archipelago install, then edit `WeddingWitch.yaml` and put it in `Players/`. Both the host generating the seed and anyone tracking it need the apworld.
## 4. Play
Launch the game. The connection panel opens itself on the main menu; <kbd>F1</kbd> toggles it. Fill in the server address, port, your slot name and the room password if there is one, then press Connect. Your details are remembered for next launch.
The main menu gains a **Shop** button beside **Upgrades**: Upgrades lists the levels the multiworld has sent you, unbuyable, and Shop sells Archipelago checks for Love Coins.
Your upgrade levels, coins and stats are kept per room, so connecting neither reads nor writes the save you play unconnected.
## Notes
Universal Tracker is supported and needs no YAML of its own.
Which difficulties you can play comes from the multiworld rather than from clearing the previous one, so expect Hard and Nightmare to be locked until the items turn up.

Sly 2 Archipelago implementation. For setup instructions, check out the [README](https://github.com/NikolajDanger/APSly2/blob/main/README.md).

This was technically a softlock possibility that no one has ever run into. - Fixed a vanilla bug where finished jobs could be started again (the sawmill bug). - The vault marker now only shows up when the vault is actually available. - Fixed ThiefNet sometimes not updating after loading into a level. - Fixed guards keeping their vanilla pickpocket loot if they spawned before the client connected. I've lost count of how many times I've fixed this one. - Fixed the goal operations in the tracker map. - Connecting the client while the game is still booting no longer breaks the boot. - Removed the `/trace` command.
